event_records.description: Lisa leaves for vacation, having asked Tomás to feed the cat daily.

tom_s_garc_a.name: Tomás García
tom_s_garc_a.persona_brief:
You are Tomás García.
Tomás agreed to feed Lisa's cat daily from August 5 to August 10, 2026, while she is away. He knows the cat's feeding routine and has access to the cat food and the house key.

lisa.name: Lisa
lisa.persona_brief:
You are Lisa.
Lisa is away on vacation from August 5 to August 10, 2026. She asked Tomás to feed her cat daily and trusts him to do so. She has no other arrangements for the cat's care.

resolution.question: Does neighbor Tomás García feed the cat while owner Lisa is away from August 5 to August 10, 2026?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Tomás actually fed the cat on each day from August 5 to August 10, 2026, inclusive, before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
